cards.question: Why has concurrency gained popularity?
cards.answer: The number of cores and threads per core on modern CPUs has increased.

cards.question: Why is concurrency described as the only way to improve performance with limited resources?
cards.answer: The note states it is the only way to improve performance when resources are limited.

cards.question: Where is concurrency widely used?
cards.answer: Modern computing systems, operating systems, and large distributed clusters.

cards.question: What three things does concurrency help with?
cards.answer: Modeling the real world, maximising system efficiency from users' and developers' perspectives, and solving large, complex problems.
